name: Muken
source:
Main character can consciously control his night dreams. He meets different exotic people and talks to them. Some terrible things happen there, but he has no extraordinary power to overwhelm them. But he has inner strength, so he has to fights to protect his happy everyday.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-december-2003-saya-no-uta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角能够有意识地控制自己夜里的梦境。他会遇见各种奇异的人，并与他们交谈。梦中也会发生一些可怕的事情，而他并没有足以压倒这些威胁的超凡力量。但他内心坚强，必须为守护幸福的日常而战。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-december-2003-saya-no-uta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
